title: The Count of the Dead
text: A grey clerk with a ledger stands at the barrow's mouth, counting the dead who pass him on their way down. His pen never stops and his ink never runs dry. He looks up at you with mild, tired eyes and asks for your fallen, so they can be written down properly.

options.label: Name your fallen, so they are not forgotten in whatever lies below.

outcomes.text: He writes each name in a careful hand. Something deep in the barrow seems satisfied, as are you.
One of the names answers from inside the barrow. Its owner walks out to join you, blinking at the light.

options.label: Refuse him your dead. They are yours to remember, not his to count.

outcomes.text: He writes something down regardless, blows on the ink and does not look up again. None of you asks whose name it was.
